g.text: Workflow 2: Multi-Region DR Failover SAGA (Singapore -> US)
• Step 1: Promote Aurora Global Cluster in us-east-1
• Step 2: Scale up DR Fargate fleet to desired count
• Step 3: Switch Route 53 DNS records to DR ALB
• Step 4: Record audit trail ledger & alert operator
